## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `<type>/<description>` and the title is a Conventional Commit
- [ ] Tried with `docker compose up -d` from a clean copy, or the change does not affect the setup
- [ ] Opened against the right branch: `main` for AnsibleForms 7, `v6` for AnsibleForms 6
